To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the students of the first year of the Pedagogy program of the Faculty of Education, University of the Americas (2017), show a high percentage of interest in the teaching-learning process (90%), in the teaching profession (87%), in the development of students (86%), in the use of ICT in the teaching-learning (85%), and in the development of their own teaching (84%).

the students who entered the Pedagogy Program at the Universidad de las Americas in 2017, have a profile of attitudes and interests that is consistent with the profile of attitudes and interest required by the Law 20.903 that created the System of Professional Teacher Development, in force for Pedagogy Programs since 2016.

The law 20.903, that created the System of Professional Development of Teachers, and that rules over the pedagogy careers since 2016, recognizes the complexity of the work of teachers and, based on different requirements, it requires to the training institutions, the design, application and accompaniment of an evaluative test for the students who enter to the formation program in pedagogy
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evaluation of the attitudes and interests of students in their first year of Pedagogy programs.

the evaluation of students entering a teaching program at the Faculty of Education at Universidad de las Americas (UDLA), in order to identify the profile of incoming students and compare it with the profile of students who are graduating from the program.

the evaluation of the first year students in pedagogy programs regarding their attitudes and interests in teaching, and the analysis of the results obtained in a test that was applied in the year 2017 in the Faculty of Education at the Universidad de las Americas.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the students who entered the Pedagogy program in the year 2017 have a positive attitude and interest in teaching, but they need to develop the practical skills that allow them to put these attitudes and interests into practice in the classroom.
the students of the first year in the Pedagogy program of the Universidad de las Americas are aware and interested in teaching, but they need to develop their attitudes in a practical way.
the students of the first year in the Pedagogy program have the necessary skills to develop their teaching practice in an effective and meaningful way.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have designed a test to measure attitudes and interests for teaching in students entering pedagogy programs.

we have been working on the design, development and implementation of a diagnostic test that allows the identification of the attitudes and interests of the incoming students of the first year of the Pedagogy program at the University of the Americas (UDLA).

the students of the Pedagogy Program have an interest in the teaching profession and a positive attitude towards the same; however, it is necessary to work on the development and strengthening of the skills that allow them to face their future professional practice.
The main takeaway from our work is that
students who have been in the classroom for less than 2 years are still developing their teaching practices and their attitudes towards their teaching practices.
the students who are admitted to the Pedagogy programs at Universidad de las Americas are not prepared for the challenges of teaching.
we have been able to show that students who are in their first year of a pedagogy program are able to identify the importance of the teaching profession and its impact on society.
